segments.name: Quantum platform
products: advanced quantum positioning, navigation and timing services
segments.description: Sells quantum computing hardware, cloud access, networking, sensing and security products and professional services to enterprises, governments and research customers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment as its Chairman and Chief Executive Officer , who is the chief operating decision maker, reviews financial information on a consolidated basis for purposes of making operating decisions, allocating resources, and evaluating financial performance.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for access to quantum computers through cloud platforms or on premises, plus hardware purchases, professional services and data-as-a-service products.
revenueModel.evidence: We also sell full quantum computing systems to customers, either over the cloud or on premises.
